Repository-relative, forward slashes; `./` is stripped. An absolute path or a
`..` segment is an invalid input.

schema.description: Which path to judge.
schema.title: ClassifyInput

reason.description: Why it is out; absent when it is in.

rule.description:
The pattern or limit that decided: the `in` pathspec, the `out` pattern, `binary`,
`max_bytes` or `fixtures.max_bytes`; absent for `undeclared`.

exists.description: Whether the path exists in the work tree; a path that does not is judged by name.

directory.description: Whether the path is a directory; a directory is in when something beneath it can be.

bytes.description: The size, when the path is an existing file.

schema.description: One path, judged.
schema.title: Classification
